about: Statistics Norway (SSB, ssb.no): search articles and statistics, read statistic, article and topic pages, and query Statbank (PxWebApi v2) tables, metadata and data, plus Klass classifications.

commands.summary: Full-text search of ssb.no content (statistics, articles, analyses, fact pages), with subject/content-type filters and date sort

params.name: subject
params.description: Main subject filter (title from the 'subjects' facet), e.g. Befolkning, 'Innvandring og innvandrere'. Empty means all subjects.

params.name: content_type
params.description: Content type filter (title from the 'contentTypes' facet), e.g. artikkel, statistikk, analysis. Empty means all types.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: best (relevance) or publiseringsdato (newest first)

commands.summary: List the sub-topics (category links) on an ssb.no main topic page

params.name: topic
params.description: Topic slug, e.g. sosiale-forhold-og-kriminalitet, befolkning, arbeid-og-lonn

commands.summary: Get a statistic page's overview: title, ingress, last and next update, subjects and keywords

params.name: subject
params.description: First URL segment of the statistic URL from search-content (e.g. befolkning in /befolkning/folketall/statistikk/befolkning)

commands.summary: Get the 'selected figures' tables shown on a statistic page (caption, header and rows as text)

params.name: subject
params.description: First URL segment of the statistic URL, e.g. befolkning

commands.summary: Get an ssb.no article: title, ingress, publish date, authors and body text

params.name: subject
params.description: First URL segment of the article URL, e.g. befolkning

commands.summary: Search or list Statbank (PxWebApi v2) tables by keyword

params.name: query
params.description: Search words, e.g. folkemengde. Use quotes for an exact phrase.

commands.summary: Get Statbank table info: label, period range, variables, subject paths, update time
Get Statbank table metadata (json-stat2): dimensions with all value codes and labels, notes, roles

params.name: default_selection
params.description: Restrict dimensions to the default selection's codelists

commands.summary: Get the default variable/value selection and layout the Statbank uses for a table
Fetch Statbank table data (json-stat2). Without selections it returns the table's default selection.

params.name: output_format
params.description: Output format (json-stat2 is parsed as JSON)

params.name: time
params.description: Time codes for variable Tid: comma list, wildcard or expression, e.g. 2026K2, top(4), from(2020)

params.name: region
params.description: Region codes for variable Region, e.g. 0 (whole country), K-0301, or * for all values in the codelist

params.name: region_codelist
params.description: Codelist for Region, e.g. agg_KommSummer (see get-table-default-selection)

params.name: contents
params.description: ContentsCode (statistics variable) codes, comma list or *

commands.summary: Search Klass, SSB's statistical classifications and code lists (e.g. NACE, municipalities, occupations)
